name: k0sctl
description: k0s cluster lifecycle tool — declaratively bootstrap and upgrade k0s Kubernetes clusters over SSH

install_steps: Download k0sctl for your platform from https://github.com/k0sproject/k0sctl/releases and move it to PATH

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install k0sctl: Download k0sctl for your platform from https://github.com/k0sproject/k0sctl/releases and move it to PATH

commands.description: Generate a starter k0sctl.yaml cluster spec (k0sctl init > k0sctl.yaml). Add hosts inline: k0sctl init --k0s user@host

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install k0sctl: Download k0sctl for your platform from https://github.com/k0sproject/k0sctl/releases and move it to PATH

commands.description: Provision or converge the cluster from k0sctl.yaml (k0sctl apply --config k0sctl.yaml). Idempotent — re-run to upgrade or scale

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install k0sctl: Download k0sctl for your platform from https://github.com/k0sproject/k0sctl/releases and move it to PATH

commands.description: Fetch the admin kubeconfig for the deployed cluster (k0sctl kubeconfig > kubeconfig.yaml)

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install k0sctl: Download k0sctl for your platform from https://github.com/k0sproject/k0sctl/releases and move it to PATH

commands.description: Back up cluster state and certificates (k0sctl backup --config k0sctl.yaml)

commands.description: Uninstall k0s and reset all hosts in k0sctl.yaml (k0sctl reset --config k0sctl.yaml)
